description: January 16 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 3, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 16 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the third decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: The January 16 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Sixteen reduces to 7, the searcher's number, and the Sun on January 16 stands about twenty-five degrees into Capricorn. The Mercury sub-ruler of this decan gives the analytical 7 plenty to work with. Expect, in interpretive terms, a sceptical and private thinker who prefers evidence to enthusiasm and trusts a few sources deeply.

Astronomically, January 16 puts the Sun near 25° Capricorn in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Mercury, ruler of Virgo, colours the last decan of Capricorn, from roughly January 11 to January 20. The sign's practical ambition is joined by a sharp, analytical mind. These natives are often described as strategists and problem-solvers who plan carefully, communicate clearly and spot the weak point in a proposal before anyone else does. Their humour can be dry and well timed. Mercury adds a restlessness that may show up as worry about details or overwork. When this decan trusts the thinking it has already done, it tends to make decisions that others recognise as sound only later.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for January 16
paragraphs: A birthday on the 16th reduces as 1 + 6 = 7, giving a birthday number of 7. In the compound, the 1 of the individual meets the 6 of home and responsibility, and the result is the 7's reflective, searching mind. Numerologists sometimes list 16 as a karmic debt number, linked with humility and rebuilding after the collapse of an outdated self-image. Those born on this day are often described as introspective, intuitive and capable of real personal reinvention. The day number is secondary, but in the 16 it frequently marks a rich inner life and a habit of questioning appearances.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a January 16 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous January 16 birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 16 is the 16th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aquarius, is usually complete within 5 days, by January 21.

In the Chinese zodiac a January 16 birth comes before the new year has turned, so the animal is the one that began the previous winter. Among the best-known people with a January 16 birthday are Susan Sontag (1933), Dian Fossey (1932) and Jennie (1996).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 16?
faq.answer: January 16 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 16?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 16 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 16th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 16?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, January 16 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 16?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on January 16 include Susan Sontag (1933), Dian Fossey (1932) and Jennie (1996). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
